about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Roti Canai with Dhal Dipping Curry
recipes.summary: Flaky, layered Malaysian flatbreads stretched thin, folded and pan-fried, served with a spiced lentil curry.
steps: Mix flour, salt, sugar, egg and water into a soft dough and knead for 8 minutes.
Divide into 8 balls, coat each in oil and rest in a covered tray for 2 hours.
Simmer onion, garlic, curry powder, tomato and lentils in the water for 20 minutes until thick and soft.
Stretch each ball on an oiled bench until paper thin, then fold into a square.
Fry in a hot pan with ghee for 3 minutes each side until golden.
Clap the roti between your hands to fluff the layers and serve with the dhal.
notes: Food safety: the egg in the dough is fully cooked by frying.
The long oiled rest is what lets the dough stretch without tearing.

recipes.title: Coconut Rice Breakfast with Sambal Eggs and Anchovies
recipes.summary: Coconut rice with crisp anchovies, peanuts, cucumber and eggs braised in a sweet chilli sambal.
steps: Rinse the rice and cook with the coconut milk, water and lemongrass for 18 minutes, then rest covered.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool and peel.
Fry the onion and garlic in oil for 6 minutes, add the chilli paste and cook 4 minutes until the oil separates.
Stir in the tamarind and sugar with a splash of water, add the eggs and coat for 3 minutes.
Fry the anchovies in a little oil for 2 minutes until crisp.
Serve the rice with sambal eggs, anchovies, peanuts and cucumber.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs for at least 8 minutes so they are set through.
Anchovies make this pescatarian, not vegetarian.

recipes.title: Sambal Belacan
recipes.summary: A fiery fresh chilli and toasted shrimp paste condiment pounded with lime, served with rice and grilled fish.
steps: Toast the shrimp paste in a dry pan for 2 minutes until crumbly and fragrant.
Crush the chillies coarsely in a mortar until broken down.
Add the shrimp paste, sugar and salt and grind until a rough paste forms.
Stir in the lime juice and oil and serve at once.
notes: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Toasting the paste mellows its smell and deepens the flavour.

recipes.title: Kangkung Belacan
recipes.summary: Water spinach stir-fried with chilli, garlic and toasted shrimp paste, a classic Malaysian side.
steps: Cut the water spinach into 8cm lengths, keeping stems and leaves apart.
Grind the garlic, chillies and shrimp paste until a rough paste forms.
Fry the paste in hot oil for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the stems and toss for 2 minutes, then the leaves, oyster sauce and sugar.
Toss for 1 minute until just wilted and serve hot.
notes: Wash the greens very well as the hollow stems hold grit.
Work on a high heat so the greens stay bright.

recipes.title: Acar Awak
recipes.summary: A Nyonya-style pickle of crunchy vegetables in a turmeric, chilli and peanut dressing.

items: 1 cucumber, deseeded and cut in batons

steps: Salt the cabbage, carrot, cucumber and beans and leave them for 20 minutes, then squeeze dry.
Blend the chillies, shallots, garlic and turmeric to a paste.
Fry the paste in oil for 5 minutes until fragrant.
Add the vinegar and sugar and simmer for 3 minutes, then cool.
Toss the vegetables with the dressing and half the peanuts.
Top with the remaining peanuts and rest for an hour before serving.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for up to 5 days.
Squeezing the vegetables dry keeps the pickle crunchy.

recipes.title: Bak Kut Teh Pork Rib Soup
recipes.summary: A peppery Klang-style pork rib soup with garlic, white pepper and soy, simmered until the meat falls away.
steps: Blanch the ribs in boiling water for 5 minutes and rinse.
Return to a clean pot with water, garlic, peppercorns, star anise and cinnamon.
Simmer gently for 90 minutes, skimming the surface, until the meat pulls from the bone.
Add the soy sauces, sugar and mushrooms and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the tofu for 5 minutes and serve with rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches at least 75°C and is tender.
Serve with chopped chilli in soy sauce.

recipes.title: Curry Laksa Noodle Soup
recipes.summary: A rich coconut curry soup with rice noodles, prawns, tofu puffs and a fragrant homemade spice paste.
steps: Soak the dried chillies in hot water for 15 minutes, then blend with shallots, garlic, lemongrass, ginger, turmeric and shrimp paste.
Fry the paste in the oil for 10 minutes until the oil separates.
Add the stock and simmer for 10 minutes, then stir in the coconut milk and fish sauce.
Cook the vermicelli until tender, then drain and divide among bowls.
Poach the prawns and tofu puffs in the soup for 3 minutes.
Ladle over the noodles and top with sprouts, mint and lime.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and opaque all through.
Freeze leftover paste in portions.

recipes.title: Kaya Toast with Soft Eggs
recipes.summary: Crisp toasted bread with sweet coconut and butter, with runny eggs seasoned with soy and white pepper.
steps: Toast the bread until crisp and golden.
Spread two slices with the sweet coconut and top with slices of cold butter.
Close the sandwiches and cut them into fingers.
Lower the eggs into boiling water for 6 minutes.
Crack into a bowl and season with soy sauce and white pepper.
Eat the toast dipped in the eggs until the plate is clean.
notes: Food safety: soft eggs are not recommended for pregnant women, older adults or small children.
Toast the coconut lightly until golden for extra flavour.

recipes.title: Rojak Buah Fruit Salad
recipes.summary: Crunchy tropical fruit and vegetables tossed in a sticky, sweet and tangy tamarind and chilli dressing with peanuts.
steps: Whisk tamarind, palm sugar, chilli paste and lime juice until the sugar dissolves.
Place the fruit and vegetables in a large bowl.
Pour over the dressing and toss well.
Scatter with peanuts and sesame seeds and serve straight away.
notes: Serve immediately or the fruit will turn watery.
Add more chilli for a hotter dressing.

recipes.title: Kuih Dadar Coconut Pancakes
recipes.summary: Thin crepes wrapped around gula melaka coconut filling.
steps: Blend the flour, egg, coconut milk, water, pandan juice and salt until smooth and rest for 20 minutes.
Melt the palm sugar with the water, add the coconut and cook for 6 minutes until sticky.
Cook thin crepes in a lightly oiled non-stick pan for 1 minute per side.
Spoon filling down the centre of each crepe.
Roll up each crepe around the filling and serve warm.
notes: Food safety: the egg is fully cooked in the crepe.
The batter should be thin like cream.

recipes.title: Crispy Anchovy and Peanut Sambal Crunch
recipes.summary: Crunchy fried anchovies and peanuts tossed in sweet chilli sambal.
steps: Fry the peanuts in oil for 4 minutes until golden and lift out.
Fry the anchovies in the same oil for 3 minutes until crisp and lift out.
Fry the onion for 3 minutes, add the chilli paste and cook 2 minutes.
Stir in the tamarind and sugar until sticky.
Fold through the anchovies and peanuts and cool before serving.
notes: Keeps for a week in a sealed jar.
Rinse and dry the anchovies well before frying.

recipes.title: Caesar Salad with Homemade Dressing
recipes.summary: Crisp cos, garlic croutons and a from-scratch anchovy and lemon dressing, topped with shaved parmesan.
steps: Tear the bread, toss with 3 tbsp oil and bake at 190C for 12 minutes until crisp.
Mash the garlic and anchovies to a paste.
Whisk in the yolk, mustard, lemon juice and worcestershire.
Drizzle in the oil, whisking until thick and glossy.
Toss the cos leaves with the dressing and croutons.
Top with shaved parmesan.
notes: Food safety: the dressing uses raw egg yolk, so avoid it for pregnant women, older adults and small children.
Use pasteurised egg yolk if you prefer.

recipes.title: Béchamel Mother Sauce
recipes.summary: The silky white sauce at the base of lasagne, gratins and cheese sauces, with a smooth roux and a hint of nutmeg.

items: 1 small onion, peeled and studded with 2 cloves

steps: Warm the milk with the onion and bay leaf for 10 minutes and strain.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook for 2 minutes without browning.
Add the hot milk a little at a time, whisking smooth after each addition.
Simmer for 8 minutes, stirring, until thick enough to coat a spoon.
Season with nutmeg and salt.
notes: Press cling film on the surface to stop a skin forming.
Add more milk if it thickens on standing.

recipes.title: Veloute Mother Sauce
recipes.summary: A light golden roux sauce built on chicken stock, the base for supremes, mushroom and tarragon sauces.
steps: Melt the butter and stir in the flour.
Cook for 3 minutes until pale blond.
Pour in the warm stock gradually, whisking smooth.
Add the bay leaf and peppercorns and simmer gently for 20 minutes, skimming.
Strain, season and finish with lemon juice.
notes: Use a good stock, as the sauce will taste only of it.
Swap in fish or veal stock for other classic versions.

recipes.title: Espagnole Brown Sauce
recipes.summary: A deep brown sauce from dark roux, roasted bones and aromatics, the foundation for a demi-glace.
steps: Brown the vegetables in half the butter for 10 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook until brick red.
Make a dark roux with the remaining butter and flour, cooking for 8 minutes until nutty brown.
Whisk in the warm stock slowly.
Add the vegetables, bay leaf and thyme and simmer for 75 minutes, skimming.
Strain through a fine sieve until smooth, then season to taste.
notes: Keeps 4 days in the fridge or freezes well.
Reduce by half with red wine for a demi-glace style sauce.

recipes.title: Mayonnaise from Scratch
recipes.summary: Rich homemade mayonnaise whisked by hand from egg yolk, mustard, lemon and oil.
steps: Whisk the yolks, mustard and lemon juice in a bowl until pale and combined.
Add the oil one drop at a time, whisking constantly.
Once it thickens, pour in the oil in a thin stream.
Whisk in the vinegar and salt.
Store covered in the fridge and use once chilled until thick.
notes: Food safety: this contains raw egg yolk, so avoid for pregnant women, older adults and small children, and use within 3 days.
Use pasteurised yolks for safety.

recipes.title: Chicken Stock, Slow-Simmered
recipes.summary: A clear, gelatinous chicken stock from roasted bones, the base for soups and sauces.
steps: Roast the carcasses at 220C for 30 minutes until golden.
Put them in a pot with the vegetables, herbs and peppercorns.
Cover with the cold water and bring to a gentle simmer until the first scum rises.
Simmer for 4 hours, skimming the surface.
Strain through a fine sieve and chill.
Lift off the fat once set and reheat the stock to steaming before using.
notes: Food safety: simmer until the chicken reaches 75°C throughout, cool quickly, store in the fridge for 4 days or freeze up to 3 months, and always reheat to steaming.
Never boil hard or the stock turns cloudy.

recipes.title: Dashi from Kombu and Bonito
recipes.summary: The foundational Japanese broth of kelp and smoked bonito flakes, clean and savoury.
steps: Soak the kombu in the water for 30 minutes.
Heat gently until just below a simmer, then remove the kombu.
Add the bonito flakes and turn off the heat.
Steep for 2 minutes until the flakes sink, then strain.
notes: Do not boil the kombu or the stock turns bitter and slimy.
Use within 3 days.

recipes.title: Kimchi, Napa Cabbage
recipes.summary: Fermented napa cabbage with chilli, garlic and ginger, pungent and tangy after a few days.
steps: Salt the cabbage between the leaves and stand for 2 hours, turning once.
Rinse three times and drain well.
Cook the rice flour with the water until a thick paste forms, then cool.
Blend the garlic, ginger, fish sauce and sugar with the gochugaru and flour paste.
Mix in the carrot, daikon and spring onion.
Rub the paste between the cabbage leaves and pack tightly into a jar.
Ferment at room temperature for 2 days until bubbly and sour, then refrigerate.
notes: Wear gloves to avoid chilli burns.
Keep the cabbage submerged and open the jar to release gas daily.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut
recipes.summary: Raw fermented cabbage salted to make its own brine, tart and crunchy.
steps: Shred the cabbage finely and mix with the salt.
Massage for 10 minutes until it releases plenty of liquid.
Mix in the caraway and fennel.
Pack tightly into a jar so the liquid covers the cabbage.
Weigh it down and ferment at room temperature for 7 to 10 days.
Refrigerate once sour enough, until the cabbage tastes tangy.
notes: Skim any scum. Discard if it smells rotten or has pink or fuzzy mould.
Use non-iodised salt.

recipes.title: Preserved Lemons
recipes.summary: Whole lemons cured in salt and their own juice, essential for tagines and dressings.
steps: Quarter the lemons almost through, keeping the base attached.
Pack the cut sides with salt.
Layer in a sterilised jar with bay and coriander.
Press down and cover with the juice of 3 lemons.
Seal and shake daily for 4 weeks until the rinds are soft.
notes: Rinse the lemons before using and use the skin only.
Keeps in the fridge for a year.

recipes.title: Pommes Anna
recipes.summary: Thin overlapping potato slices pressed in butter and baked until golden, crisp outside and tender within.
steps: Slice the potatoes very finely and keep them dry.
Brush a frying pan with butter and arrange a circle of slices overlapping like fish scales.
Season each layer, brush with butter and add thyme.
Repeat until all are used, pressing firmly.
Cover with foil and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake 25 minutes until crisp and golden.
Rest, loosen the edge and turn out.
notes: Do not rinse the starch off the slices as it helps them bind.
Use a mandoline for even slices.

recipes.title: Duchess Potatoes
recipes.summary: Piped mashed potato rosettes baked until golden and crisp at the edges.
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender and drain well.
Steam dry in the pot for 3 minutes and mash until smooth.
Beat in the butter, yolks, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Pipe rosettes onto a lined tray.
Brush with the beaten egg and bake at 220C for 25 minutes until golden.
notes: Food safety: bake until the egg is fully cooked and golden.
A dry mash is the secret to piping neatly.

recipes.title: Yorkshire Puddings
recipes.summary: Tall, crisp, airy puddings baked in smoking-hot fat, perfect with roast beef and gravy.
steps: Whisk the flour, eggs, milk and salt until a smooth batter forms.
Rest the batter for 30 minutes until it thickens slightly.
Heat the oven to 230C and add a spoonful of dripping to each cup of a muffin tin.
Heat the tin until smoking, about 10 minutes.
Pour in the batter and bake for 22 minutes without opening the door.
notes: Food safety: bake until the eggs are fully set.
Keep the fat very hot or the puddings will not rise.

recipes.title: Gratin Dauphinois
recipes.summary: Thinly sliced potatoes baked in garlicky cream and milk until bubbling and tender.
steps: Rub a baking dish with the garlic and butter.
Slice the potatoes thinly and layer in the dish.
Heat the cream, milk, nutmeg and salt until just steaming.
Pour the hot cream mixture over the potatoes until just covered.
Bake at 170C for 70 minutes until golden and tender.
notes: This version uses no cheese.
Cover with foil if it browns too fast.

recipes.title: Romesco Sauce
recipes.summary: A smoky red pepper and almond sauce, a Catalan classic for grilled vegetables and fish.
steps: Roast the capsicums, tomatoes and garlic at 220C for 25 minutes.
Peel the charred skins from the capsicum until the flesh is clean.
Toast the almonds until golden.
Blend the almonds, toast and garlic until a coarse paste forms.
Add the vegetables, vinegar and paprika and blend.
Stream in the oil and season.
notes: It thickens as it rests.
Keeps 5 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Salsa Macha
recipes.summary: A Veracruz oil-based salsa of dried chilli, nuts and garlic, nutty, smoky and addictive.
steps: Warm the oil with the garlic until golden and lift out the garlic.
Fry the chillies for 30 seconds until they darken slightly, then lift out.
Fry the peanuts and sesame in the oil until golden.
Blend half the mixture coarsely.
Stir all together with vinegar, sugar and salt.
notes: Keep submerged in oil in the fridge for up to 3 weeks.
Do not let the chillies burn or the sauce turns bitter.

recipes.title: Mole Poblano
recipes.summary: A deep chilli, chocolate and spice sauce with sesame and nuts, long and slow in the making.
steps: Toast and deseed the chillies and soak in hot water for 20 minutes.
Fry the onion, garlic, tomato, nuts, seeds, raisins, tortilla and spices in the lard until brown.
Blend with the chillies and some soaking water.
Fry the paste in a pot for 10 minutes, stirring.
Add the stock and chocolate and simmer for an hour until glossy and thick.
Season with salt and sugar to balance.
notes: Serve over turkey or chicken.
Freezes well in portions.

recipes.title: Harissa from Scratch
recipes.summary: Fiery Tunisian chilli paste with roasted capsicum, caraway, cumin and garlic.
steps: Soak the chillies in hot water for 20 minutes and drain.
Toast the spices in a dry pan until fragrant.
Blend the chillies, capsicum, garlic and spices to a paste.
Stir in the lemon juice and oil and season.
notes: Cover with a film of oil and keep for 3 weeks in the fridge.
Wear gloves.

recipes.title: XO Sauce
recipes.summary: Luxurious Cantonese seafood condiment of dried scallop, shrimp, ham and chilli slowly cooked in oil.
steps: Soak the scallops and shrimp in hot water until soft and shred the scallops.
Chop the ham, shallots, garlic and chillies finely.
Warm the oil and fry the shallots and garlic gently for 15 minutes until golden.
Add the ham, shrimp, scallops and chillies and cook for 20 minutes.
Add the oyster sauce, sugar and wine and simmer 5 minutes until glossy.
notes: Food safety: the dried seafood is rehydrated and cooked in hot oil for 20 minutes until opaque and cooked through, so keep it refrigerated under oil and use within a month.
Great with noodles, eggs and steamed fish.

recipes.title: Dairy-Free Ranch Dressing
recipes.summary: Creamy herbed cashew ranch with chives, dill and garlic, no dairy needed.
steps: Soak the cashews in boiling water for 20 minutes and drain.
Blend with the water, lemon, garlic, vinegar and onion powder until very smooth.
Stir in the chives and dill.
Chill for 30 minutes until the dressing thickens slightly.
notes: Thins out in the fridge, so add water if too thick.
Keeps 5 days.

recipes.title: Gribiche Sauce
recipes.summary: A cold French sauce of hard-boiled eggs, mustard, capers and herbs for asparagus and cold fish.
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes and cool.
Mash the yolks with mustard and vinegar.
Whisk in the oil in a thin stream until glossy and thick.
Chop the whites and fold in with capers, cornichons and herbs.
Season with salt and serve until the bowl is empty.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs for 10 minutes until firm throughout.
Use within 2 days.

recipes.title: Brioche Cinnamon Rolls
recipes.summary: Soft, buttery brioche dough rolled with cinnamon sugar and iced with cream cheese frosting.
steps: Mix flour, yeast, sugar and salt with milk and eggs.
Knead in the butter until silky, about 10 minutes.
Prove for 90 minutes until doubled.
Roll to a rectangle, spread with softened butter and cinnamon sugar.
Roll up and cut into 8 pieces.
Prove 45 minutes in a pan.
Bake at 180C for 28 minutes.
Beat cream cheese with icing sugar and spread over warm rolls.
notes: Food safety: bake until the rolls are cooked through.
Warm milk should be no hotter than 40C.

recipes.title: Homemade Bagels
recipes.summary: Chewy, shiny bagels shaped by hand, boiled in honey water, then baked.
steps: Mix flour, salt, yeast, honey and water and knead for 10 minutes.
Prove for 1 hour until doubled in size.
Divide into 8 and shape into rings.
Rest the rings for 20 minutes until slightly puffy.
Boil in the honey water for 1 minute each side.
Top with sesame and bake at 220C for 20 minutes.
notes: Boiling gives the shiny, chewy crust.
Slice and freeze for easy breakfasts.

recipes.title: Sourdough Crumpets
recipes.summary: Tangy, hole-riddled crumpets cooked in rings in a pan, ideal for butter to soak into.
steps: Whisk the discard, flour, milk, salt and sugar into a batter.
Rest the batter for 1 hour until bubbles appear on top.
Dissolve the bicarb in the water and stir through.
Heat greased rings in a pan on low heat.
Fill the rings 1cm deep and cook for 8 minutes until set and dotted with holes.
Flip and cook for 1 minute until pale gold on top.
notes: Eat with melted butter.
Reheat in the toaster.

recipes.title: Japanese Soufflé Pancakes
recipes.summary: Tall, wobbly meringue-lightened pancakes cooked slowly under a lid.
steps: Whisk the yolks, milk and vanilla and fold in flour and baking powder.
Whisk the whites with the sugar to stiff peaks.
Fold the meringue into the batter in thirds until no streaks remain.
Pile mounds into a low-heat buttered pan.
Cover and cook for 6 minutes, flip and cook for 5 more.
Serve the stacks straight away with maple syrup.
notes: Food safety: cook gently until the centres are set.
Keep the heat low.

recipes.title: Tofu Scramble with Greens
recipes.summary: A dairy-free, high-protein scramble of turmeric tofu, spinach and tomatoes on toast.
steps: Crumble the tofu into a bowl.
Warm the oil and cook the tofu with turmeric and cumin for 5 minutes.
Stir in the yeast, spinach and tomato until wilted.
Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Pile the scramble on top.
notes: Press the tofu first for a firmer texture.
Add black salt for an eggy flavour.

recipes.title: Egg White and Spinach Frittata
recipes.summary: A lean, high-protein baked frittata with egg whites, whole eggs and greens.
steps: Soften the capsicum and spring onion in the oil.
Add the spinach until wilted.
Whisk the egg whites and eggs.
Pour over the vegetables.
Cook for 3 minutes, then bake at 180C for 12 minutes.
notes: Food safety: cook until the eggs are set through.
Great cold for the work week.

recipes.title: High-Protein Peanut Butter Oats
recipes.summary: Creamy oats cooked with soy milk, peanut butter and sesame, finished with banana.
steps: Simmer the oats and milk for 4 minutes.
Whisk in the protein powder until no lumps remain.
Stir through the peanut butter and sesame until smooth.
Top with sliced apple and serve warm.
notes: Add more milk if too thick.
Dairy-free and vegan.

recipes.title: Tuna and White Bean Salad
recipes.summary: Protein-rich tuna, creamy cannellini beans and red onion in a lemon and parsley dressing.
steps: Drain the tuna and beans.
Slice the onion very thinly and soak it in water for 5 minutes.
Mix with parsley and tomato.
Dress with lemon juice and oil until everything is glossy.
Season with salt and serve until the bowl is empty.
notes: Food safety: keep refrigerated and eat within 2 days.
Rinse the beans.

recipes.title: Edamame and Soba Salad
recipes.summary: Chewy soba, edamame, cucumber and carrot in a ginger sesame dressing.
steps: Boil the soba for 5 minutes and rinse under cold water.
Cook the edamame for 3 minutes.
Whisk the soy, oil, vinegar and ginger.
Toss with the noodles and vegetables until coated.
Top with sesame seeds and serve cold.
notes: Use 100% buckwheat soba for gluten free.
Vegan.
